deepdive.divline: - AAA Stable / A1+ ratings maintained (CRISIL, CARE, India Ratings)

profile.entities: GSPC Group (Govt. of Gujarat undertaking); parent GSPC; GSPL/GTL relisting via scheme of arrangement; GAIL (CBG); McKinsey (strategy consultant)
profile.mgmt: Devendra Agarwal (ED – Commercial); Rajesh Sivadasan (CFO & Head IR); Sandeep Dave (Co. Sec. & Head Corp Comms); Dipen Chauhan (Head – Industrial Marketing & BD)
profile.subseg: Industrial PNG (Morbi ceramics-heavy); CNG; Domestic/Commercial PNG; new GAs
profile.themes: Gas-economy / CGD; LNG global supply glut (2026-28); CNG-mobility shift

bull_bear.body:
- AAA Stable / A1+ ratings maintained (CRISIL, CARE, India Ratings).
- **Scheme of arrangement / merger:** Filed with MCA; final hearing expected mid-Feb 2026; scheme completion by end-April including share allotment to GGL & GTL shareholders + **GSPL/GTL relisting** expected before next earnings call (~May 2026, when merged/full financials reported).
- Consolidated balance sheet & net-cash detail deferred to March results.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **Morbi propane substitution:** Single largest swing risk — volumes halved YoY (3.35→1.66) on cheaper propane; recovery depends on propane price rising (+$25-30/ton for parity).
- **Morbi ceramic-export demand:** Older units closing (obsolete products), offset by new units; capacity utilization 7–7.5 of >8 MMSCMD installed.
- **LNG/spot price volatility:** Winter spike; rupee depreciation; geopolitical disruption (shipping routes); Golden Pass / Qatar NFE project delays.
- **APM allocation:** Overall priority-segment (Domestic+CNG) shortfall **51%** (CNG shortfall 64%); APM only 24% of portfolio — rising reliance on spot/long-term.
- **Regulatory:** PNGRB open-access litigation in Delhi HC — GGL holds "no coercive" interim order; final verdict not near-term (infra creation continuing, no stay).
bull_bear.title: Risks

bull_bear.body: Confident and concrete. Clearly bullish on Morbi recovery (specific monthly volume path 2.2→2.6/2.7→3.0-3.2), upbeat on CNG (raised target to 13%) and >1,000 stations. Candid that FY27 volume guidance hinges on propane economics; deferred to March/April. Closing: "favorable gas price regime... we expect better numbers in Q4."
bull_bear.title: Management tone

bull_bear.body:
- Morbi recovery already visible **in-quarter** (Jan): 1.68→2.2 MMSCMD before the call, i.e. Q3 print understates exit run-rate.
- GGL turning the propane threat into an opportunity — plans to **sell propane itself** (using existing customer financial securities/credit as a competitive hedge vs other suppliers requiring advance payment).
- ₹1/scm gross-margin headwind from new Trunkline tariff kicks in as Morbi volumes rise past ~8.7-8.8 MMSCMD — a margin offset to the volume recovery.
- EBITDA/scm guidance includes other income; ₹6.5 mechanically = ₹502cr/8.4 MMSCMD.
- CNG growth (+11%) far outpaced station count (flat ~833 for 2-3 yrs) via daughter-booster→online conversions (≈free capacity) — now ~50% online with conversion headroom.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious insights

business.body:
- **Industrial / Morbi:** The swing factor. Q3 trough at 1.6–1.66 MMSCMD on propane competitiveness; sharp recovery underway. Morbi price cut ₹4.5/scm; **non-Morbi industrial priced ~₹3/scm premium** to Morbi.
- **CNG:** Strongest performer — +11% YoY; Guj 2.95 / outside-Guj 0.51 MMSCMD; outside-Guj +22%. ~45% cheaper than petrol, ~23% cheaper than diesel. 833 stations (415 = ~50% online; >40 daughter-booster→online converted in 2 yrs).
- **Domestic/Commercial:** Steady; 23.83 lakh domestic (+38–40k/qtr), 15,897 commercial; new GAs maturing.
business.title: Segment detail

business.body:
- **Beneficiaries ✅:** GGL itself if it captures Morbi propane market share via parent GSPC port infra; CNG OEMs / CNG vehicle ecosystem (45% petrol cost advantage). ⭐ Long-term gas suppliers as GGL moves to 60-70% term contracts.
- **Pressured:** Pure spot-LNG exposure; APM-dependent priority-segment supply (51% shortfall). Morbi ceramic units facing export-demand / obsolescence churn.

---
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries

latest_quarter.body:
- EBITDA/scm ₹6.5 in Q3 (vs ₹5.04 YoY). Jan price cut is **complete spot-cost pass-through — no margin impact** unless spot rises.
- Gas cost only fell ~₹0.20/scm QoQ despite lower crude/APM/spot — because APM is only 24% of portfolio and spot/crude spread higher than last year.
- **Sourcing mix (of ~8.5 MMSCMD):** APM **24%**, New Well Gas **4%** (0.31 MMSCMD, down from 0.44), long-term **39%**, short-term (spot+IGX) **33%** (short-term up to 30% from 18% QoQ per Commercial ED).
- Blended realization ~₹47.5/scm (flattish QoQ — Morbi volume fell but prices held until Jan cut).
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost (LNG/spot vs propane)

latest_quarter.title: QoQ Log

outlook.body:
- **Morbi volume recovery:** 1.68 → **2.2 MMSCMD** (current run-rate post-cut); expect **2.6–2.7** by end-Jan (on new Saudi CP), and **3.0–3.2 MMSCMD in Feb & March**. To reach 5 MMSCMD, "differential should not be there" (parity = 5).
- **EBITDA/scm band:** Full-year FY26 **₹5.5–₹6.5/scm**; mgmt says take "same rates" for FY27/28 (update at March results).
- **New-GA / CNG rollout:** >10 CNG stations this FY, balance next FY; 78 FDODO agreements signed (first FDODO online stations commissioned at Morbi & Dwarka); target **>1,000 CNG stations in 2-3 yrs** (from 833); CNG growth target lifted toward **13%** (from 11%).
- **Capex:** 9M spend INR 408 cr; **full-year FY26 INR 650–700 cr**; ~INR 700 cr/yr run-rate for standalone CGD business going forward.
- **FY27 volume guidance:** Deferred to March/April — CNG & domestic ~10%+/double-digit; industrial dependent on propane-gas prices.
- **Sourcing target:** Long-term gas share to rise from 39% to **60–70% by end-FY27**.
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL)

outlook.body:
- Total operating volume ~8.37–8.5 MMSCMD; revenue-neutral on revised Trunkline zonal tariff up to ~8.7–8.8 MMSCMD (then ~₹1/scm gross-margin hit per 1 MMSCMD Morbi rise).
- Pipeline network ~44,540–44,550 km (PE + steel). 27 GAs, 6 states + 1 UT.
- New steel pipeline almost commissioned for Dholera; connecting Dahej business parks, Thane/Boisar.
outlook.title: Volume / pipeline

outlook.body:
- **New GAs:** Ahmedabad rural, Dahej, Kutch, Thane, Valsad, UDI (MP), Dholera — infra in place, expecting good industrial volume growth over 2-3 yrs.
- **CNG mobility:** 45% petrol headroom; FDODO model + new vehicle tech; >1,000 stations target.
- **Biogas/CBG:** 8 new tripartite agreements with biogas producers + GAIL this quarter → 27 total CBG agreements.
- **Propane trading optionality:** Parent GSPC identifying port locations for propane storage/unloading; GGL to sell propane to retain Morbi customers (capacity-charge model, no GGL capex). Could gain propane market share in Morbi.
- **McKinsey** engaged for organic + inorganic growth strategy.
outlook.title: Growth / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Largest Indian CGD by volume; near-term volume swings entirely on Morbi industrial demand (propane-vs-gas economics), while CNG (+11% YoY) and domestic/commercial provide steady structural growth — Q3 was a Morbi-driven trough with sharp sequential recovery already underway (1.66 → 2.2 MMSCMD post Jan price cut).

meta.thesis: Largest Indian CGD by volume; near-term volume swings entirely on Morbi industrial demand (propane-vs-gas economics), while CNG (+11% YoY) and domestic/commercial provide steady structural growth — Q3 was a Morbi-driven trough with sharp sequential recovery already underway (1.66 → 2.2 MMSCMD post Jan price cut).
